author: Home
title: Apple's Big iPhone Event: What to Expect This Wednesday - TheStreet
text:
It's like Christmas in September for Apple ( AAPL ) lovers.
The world's most valuable company is unveiling a bunch of new products starting this Wednesday, September, 12, 2018, in the Steve Jobs Theater at the company's super cool, spaceship-looking brand new round Apple Park headquarters in Cupertino, California.
Now keep in mind these product announcements are basically based on speculation, so no one really knows the truth until the curtain goes up at 1pm EST, Wednesday.
Or what the stock is going to do. While it is up almost 36% year-to-date, it does tend to fall off after these announcements.
Our reporters will be covering the event wall-to-wall and our very own Annie Gaus is taking her own maiden voyage to "spaceship" Apple and will be chronicling the event from the ground.
So watch now to see what analysts are expecting, but the be sure to stay tuned to for more.
